acceptanceCriteria: A gem repo whose Gemfile says `gemspec` and whose root gemspec declares rspec as a development dependency gets bundle exec rspec, covered by a test
The read is bounded and uses the committed blob; an absent or oversized gemspec keeps the unknown line
NGI-V0 is amended; focused tests pass
body: Residual from V1-1805 (PR #1145, NGI-V0-052). Gem repositories often declare rspec only via add_development_dependency in *.gemspec, with the Gemfile containing just `gemspec`. NGI-V0-052 reads only the Gemfile and Gemfile.lock, so these repos get no RSpec command. That is conservative but a gap. Expected: a bounded read of the root *.gemspec when the Gemfile says `gemspec`, or Gemfile.lock coverage proving the gem. Observed in PR #1145, 2026-10-18.
title: Ruby verification ignores rspec declared only as a gemspec development dependency
